title: The margin field
text: A field in the Biosphere Report's packet header that our own copies leave empty and our archive calls padding. At the Sela relay (relay-read) it is filled in: one number per sol that rises when the colony does well. It is the experiment's score as Meridian keeps it. The relay forwards three carriers: one to Ash, two the Archivist can't trace (Cinder and Teth).
